title: Q3LOCK R-497 independent claim/result lineage decision
question: Is the existing R-497 result manifest and RESULTS-LEDGER entry an adequate independent registration for the Q3LOCK paper, or must a new TECT claim card be created before external review?
method: Read the binding claim-card standard and compare its Sector A-F scope with the Q3LOCK paper's result-level authority.
Inspect the R-497 manifest, RESULTS-LEDGER entry, C6 status card, package manifest, and readiness surfaces.
Test whether a second T0 card would add independent mathematical content or instead duplicate the result authority and blur C6 routing metadata with a physical claim.
finding: R-497 is already a standalone T0 claim-nonbearing result registration with a pinned authority chain, bounded statement, evidence role, open gates, nonclaims, and reproducible artifacts. The C6 claim_context is routing/provenance metadata only. A new canonical claim card would duplicate the result and risk an unauthorised Sector/C6 interpretation.
decision_reason: The claim standard reserves canonical cards for Sector A-F theory claims, while the paper is intentionally an independent mathematical result package. Keeping R-497 at result level preserves lineage without promoting an unreviewed theorem or attaching it to the unrelated C6 physical scaffold.
boundary: T0 claim/result-lineage routing decision only; no theorem promotion, claim-tier change, physical conclusion, novelty or priority claim, or PDF status change.
next_action: Record the decision in the R-497 manifest and paper readiness surfaces, rerun consistency checks, and obtain signed mathematical/literature review before content freeze and any PDF generation.
non_claims: No new claim card is a theorem or a substitute for external mathematical review.
No C6, Sector A, CP1, physical, continuum, KMS, ground-state, or cosmological conclusion changes.
No novelty, priority, or literature-absence claim is made.
